headlines.title: 코스피 장 초반 7000선 회복 ...15거래일 만
headlines.summary: 美 물가·반도체 훈풍 영향 코스피 지수가 미국의 인플레이션 우려 완화와 반도체주 강세에 힘입어 장 초반 7000선을 넘어섰다. 지난달 말 급락 이후 반등세가 이어지면서 15거래일 만에 다시 7000 고지를 밟았다. 14일 한국거래소에 따르면 코스피는 장 초반 전 거래일 종가(6813.34)보다 3% 안팎 오르며 7000선을 돌파했다.

headlines.title: 수입물가 두달 연속 하락 … 반도체 호황에 수출물가는 상승
headlines.summary: 7월 수입물가 전달보다 1%↓ D램 등 주도 수출물가는 1%↑ 지난달 수입물가가 원·달러 환율과 국제유가 하락 영향으로 두 달 연속으로 떨어졌다. 반면 반도체 호황에 수출물가는 올랐고, 한국 경제의 대외 구매력을 나타내는 교역조건도 큰 폭으로 개선됐다. 14일 한국은행이 발표한 7월 수출입물가지수 및 무역지수에 따르면 지난달 수입물가지수는 160.

headlines.title: ‘ 관세 ’보다 ‘ 환율 변동성 ’이 무섭다 ...중견기업 47.3%, “수출 악화...

headlines.title: “ 숙련공 필요하지만 인건비 부담 ”… 중기 ‘ 정년연장 ’ 딜레마

key_headlines.title: Import Prices Fall for Second Consecutive Month While Export Prices Rise on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: July import prices dropped 1% month-over-month due to weakening won-dollar exchange rates and declining international oil prices, while export prices rose 1% driven by semiconductor strength, improving Korea's overall trade terms significantly.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Recovers 7000 Level for First Time in 15 Trading Days Amid US Inflation Relief and Chip Strength
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI index surpassed the 7000 mark for the first time in 15 trading days, buoyed by easing US inflation concerns and strong semiconductor stocks, demonstrating recovery momentum after last month's sharp decline.

key_headlines.title: Government Doubles Household Loan Growth Target to 3% to Ease Housing Finance Bottlenecks
key_headlines.summary: The government raised its household loan growth target from 1.5% to 3% to alleviate supply issues in housing-related cluster lending, including down payment, interim payment, and final payment loans affecting reconstruction projects.

key_headlines.title: Mid-Market Exporters Fear Currency Volatility More Than Tariffs, Seek New Markets
key_headlines.summary: Mid-sized exporters cite currency fluctuations as their primary export concern over tariffs, with 47.3% worried about export deterioration and increasing interest in diversifying markets toward Southeast Asia and India.

key_headlines.title: Government Announces Comprehensive Real Estate Stabilization Plan with Deregulation and Supply Acceleration Measures
key_headlines.summary: The government introduced an 8.13 real estate plan featuring increased housing loan quotas, green belt deregulation, expedited public land development, and reduced consent requirements for redevelopment projects to boost housing supply.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is showing strengthened recovery momentum driven by robust export performance and improving domestic consumption. The semiconductor boom is providing particular tailwinds, with export prices rising 1% in July while import prices fell due to favorable exchange rates and oil prices. However, persistent challenges remain including elevated unemployment at 2.6%, ongoing inflation pressures particularly in services, and vulnerability in certain employment sectors. The government maintains cautious optimism while acknowledging headwinds from Middle East tensions and US tariff uncertainties.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government upgraded its economic assessment to show strengthening recovery trends as exports increased significantly and domestic demand improved in July. Employment growth accelerated with 108,000 more jobs than year-ago levels, though the unemployment rate ticked up 0.2 percentage points to 2.6%. Consumer inflation moderated to 2.8% in July from 3.2% in June, but service sector prices remain elevated at 3.5%. The government acknowledges ongoing challenges including vulnerable employment conditions for vulnerable groups, high energy prices, and uncertainty from geopolitical risks and US trade policies.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI rebounded to the 7000 level after recovering from last month's sharp decline, driven by easing US inflation expectations and strong semiconductor sector performance. However, extreme volatility continues with approximately 1.2 million retail investor accounts facing margin calls as of late July, reflecting widespread leverage in the market. International markets also strengthened with US indices rising on softer inflation data, though concerns remain about record US Treasury issuance and global economic uncertainties. The KOSDAQ declined on the day despite KOSPI gains.
sections.Industry & Technology: The government announced regional industrial electricity rate reductions of up to 10% for the Yeunghonam region, providing substantial cost advantages to semiconductor clusters and energy-intensive industries like steel and petrochemicals. Korean researchers identified a new factor degrading lithium-ion battery lifespan related to uneven charge distribution at the electrode particle level, with implications for electric vehicles and energy storage systems. The discovery may lead to improved battery longevity and performance. Industrial production supports ongoing structural improvements in manufacturing competitiveness.
sections.Real Estate: The government implemented comprehensive measures to address housing finance constraints and accelerate supply, including raising household loan quotas and introducing incentives for rapid development in reconstruction projects. Moving expenses and interim payment loans are now more accessible to support residents displaced by redevelopment. The government is expanding public housing supply through green belt deregulation and innovative ownership models allowing younger and middle-aged households to build equity over time. Measures also target reducing illegal gap investments while addressing persistent jeonse (deposit lease) market tensions through increased non-apartment housing supply.
sections.International Economy: The US inflation data releases eased Fed rate hike concerns, with markets pricing in a 65.4% probability of rate maintenance at the September FOMC meeting, supporting global risk appetite. However, the US government flagged South Korea among 40 countries as potential transshipment hubs for evading Chinese tariffs, particularly mentioning the Gyeonggi semiconductor belt as a concern. The US Treasury auction saw record 30-year bond yields at 25-year highs, reflecting elevated federal debt near 40 trillion dollars with debt-to-GDP ratios at 123%. Global economic growth remains moderate but clouded by Middle East tensions and expanding US trade uncertainties.
sections.AI & Economy: Major technology companies are accelerating AI deployment with Google launching its lightweight Gemini 3.7 Flash model emphasizing coding and agent task performance with improved speed and cost efficiency. SK Group is preparing major announcements regarding approximately 100 trillion won in data center investments in the Jeonnam Dongbu region, signaling continued capital concentration in AI infrastructure. Financial services companies including NH Nonghyup are institutionalizing AI adoption through enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, incorporating generative AI services and automated workflow tools. Research indicates the top 20% of companies are capturing 74% of AI-generated economic value, highlighting growing inequality in AI benefits.
sections.Others: Homplus resumed operations at 67 stores after securing 200 billion won in emergency funding, with cooperating businesses receiving 5.4 trillion won in extended payment terms and repayment deferrals to address liquidity crises. A US Supreme Court ruling on tariff authority is enabling approximately 40 US companies including Apple and Nike to claim 9.6 billion dollars in tariff refunds. Youth employment deteriorated significantly with 190,000 net job losses year-over-year despite overall economic recovery, creating disconnect between macro prosperity and micro job market conditions. Busan Education Office allocated 77 billion won in supplementary budget focusing on public education competitiveness and student-centered welfare.
